notes: Single-page House simple resolution (H. Res. 1399, Engrossed in House, 3234 chars, fully read). Directs the Committee on Ethics and the Office of Congressional Workplace Rights to publish, within 60 days of adoption, (A) a named list of Members/Delegates/Resident Commissioners with taxpayer-funded sexual-harassment/abuse settlements plus amounts, and aggregate totals for (B) member non-misconduct, (C) employee misconduct, and (D) employee non-misconduct settlements, with (2) an any-component classification rule. Every substantive content claim is SUPPORTED with a verbatim receipt. No referencedSources. Coverage/omission pass: all four disclosure clauses (A)-(D) plus the (2) classification rule are represented; no material provision omitted. likelihoodReason vote figures (420-0, present 1, June 30 2026) verify against cache votes[], not the bill text. Two minor UNSUPPORTED extrinsic items in likelihoodReason: the "Roll no. 233" roll number (absent from source and cache votes[]) and the "takes effect on House adoption" civics gloss. 0 material issues.
